old: > "Therefore, since all things are not produced by pure chance or by the unguided mechanics of matter, and since God Himself cannot reasonably be thought to do all things directly and through constant miracles, it may well be concluded that there is a Plastic Nature an unconscious but purposeful creative power within the material world that acts as an instrument of divine will beneath Him.
new: > "Therefore, since neither all things are produced fortuitously, or by the unguided mechanism of matter, nor God himself may be reasonably thought to do all things immediately and miraculously, it may well be concluded that there is a Plastic Nature under him, which, as an inferior and subordinate instrument, doth grudgingly execute that part of his providence which consists in the regular and orderly motion of matter;

old: ‘Mana’ This power is beyond the ordinary ability of men and outside the common processes of nature. It is present in the very atmosphere of life, attaches itself to people and to objects, and is revealed through results that can only be explained by its influence.
new: ‘Mana.’ beyond the ordinary power of men, outside the common processes of nature; it is present in the atmosphere of life, attaches itself to persons and to things, and is manifested by results which can only be ascribed to its operation.

old: " Gaozi [Master Gao] says: For those who know how to prevent harm to body and mind, the effects on prolonging life are twenty-fold: Regulating oneself according to the four seasons and protecting oneself at dawn and dusk can prolong life.
new: Master Gao stated: "Knowing what harms the body and mind brings the efficacy of extending one's years: Harmonizing and regulating oneself through the twenty-four hours, and protecting oneself morning and evening, can extend one's years.

old: The Yangsheng Fang Daoyin Fa [Prescriptions for Nurturing Life: Methods of Guiding and Pulling] states: Sit straight and exert force on the waist and chest, lift the head, bring both hands together, and press them forward against the mat.
new: Methods of nourishing vitality and daoyin [guiding and pulling exercises] state: Sit upright, extend the waist and chest, and look up, raising the head. Place the fingers of both hands facing each other, pressing firmly forward against the mat so that the body is taut.

old: The Dao Yin Fa [Method of Guiding and Pulling] of the Yang Sheng Fang states: Sit straight with the waist erect, raise the left hand with the palm facing upward, push back the right arm, and cover it with the right hand.
new: The Prescriptions for Nourishing Life on daoyin [guiding and pulling exercises] state: Sit and straighten the waist. Raise the left hand with the palm facing upward. Draw back the right arm with the right hand facing downward.

old: The Lord said: If one consumes herbal medicines but does not know the methods of fangzhong [the arts of the bedchamber], as well as xingqi [circulating breath] and daoyin [guiding and pulling exercises], then taking the medicine is of no benefit.
new: The Lord said: "If one ingests herbs and botanical medicines but does not understand the arts of the bedchamber, and does not practice circulating the qi [vital energy] and gymnastic exercises daoyin [guiding and pulling exercises], taking medicine yields no benefit, and one will ultimately never attain the Way.

old: closing the breath and swallowing it, which is called Embryonic Breathing [a deep, internal meditation on breath]. Practice rinsing the spring beneath the tongue and swallowing it, which is called Embryonic Eating [the practice of swallowing saliva for nourishment].
new: holding the qi [breath] and swallowing it is called taixi [embryonic breathing]. Rinsing the mouth with the spring beneath the tongue and swallowing it is called taishi [embryonic feeding].

old: Once the Mysterious Embryo has formed, it generates its own body; this is the Neidan [Internal Elixir], the way of immortality. Energy breathes from within the formed embryo.
new: Once the mysterious embryo has formed, it spontaneously generates the body; this is the way of the internal elixir and deathlessness.

old: At the beginning of cultivating the elixir [neidan/internal alchemy], use the Root of Heaven and Earth [the primal source] as the root of the medicine, and use the Mother of Yin and Yang [the origin of duality] as the mother of the elixir.
new: When beginning the cultivation of the elixir, one takes the root of Heaven and Earth as the root of the medicine, and takes the mother of yin [receptive cosmic force] and yang [active cosmic force] as the mother of the elixir.

old: If taken for one to two years, one will "return to youth" [Fandao Huantong], with a complexion like a lotus flower and all illnesses removed. This was originally the technique of the transcendents. Believe it!
new: Take for one to two years, and you will return from old age to youth, your facial appearance becoming like a lotus flower, and all illnesses will be eliminated. This is fundamentally the method of the immortals. Believe in it, believe in it!

new: Such manual work was the great protection of the hermit against the monastic sin of "accidie"; the restless misery and boredom which comes over the contemplative when his spiritual insight fails him,

old: Since all these occur suddenly, causing the blood and qi to become isolated and unable to nourish the body together, it is necessary to properly bind and massage them and practice daoyin [guiding and pulling exercises] to restore the blood and qi.
new: These are all damages brought on suddenly. Consequently, blood and qi are cut off and obstructed, unable to circulate and nourish together. For this reason, one must skillfully apply bindings, massage, and practice daoyin [therapeutic exercise] to restore the blood and qi.

All take diligent effort and the avoidance of overexertion as their goal. Now, the circulation of energy can cure a hundred diseases, ward off plagues, forbid evil spirits, stop bleeding from wounds, allow one to dwell under water, avoid hunger and thirst, and prolong one's life. new: qi [vital energy]; third, ingest medicinal substances. In all these three matters, each possesses its own particular method. If one does not receive the authentic transmission, they are exceedingly difficult to encounter. Therefore, the arts of preserving jing [vital essence] number in the hundreds, and the recipes for ingesting medicinal substances number approximately one thousand. All take diligent effort without excessive strain as their duty. Circulating qi can cure the hundred ailments, expel epidemics, ward off demonic apparitions, halt bleeding from sores, allow one to dwell under water, stave off hunger and thirst, and prolong the lifespan. Its primary and essential point is simply taixi [embryonic breathing].

old: Those who seek to become immortals but have not yet obtained the Great Elixirs should all take this pill. If one cannot abstain from sexual activity or grain consumption, simply taking this will still eliminate all diseases and allow for long life without aging. When compounding the medicine, it must be done on a Dragon day [Chen day] at the Dragon hour [7-9 AM] in an empty room. One’s clothing must be clean, and one must not allow chickens, dogs, women, or those in mourning to see the process. Li Babo’s Apricot Golden Elixir Formula Take five dou [approximately 50 liters] of plump,
new: Those who aspire to seek immortality but have not yet attained the great elixirs must all take this. Even those who cannot abstain from sexual intercourse or sever grain consumption need only take it to dispel the myriad illnesses, causing a person to achieve longevity without aging. When compounding the medicine, one must choose a chen day and chen hour the fifth terrestrial branch, corresponding to the dragon and 7:00 to 9:00 AM inside an empty room. One's garments must be pure and clean. Do not allow chickens, dogs, women, or sons in mourning to catch sight of it. Master Li Baba's Golden Apricot Elixir Formula Take five dou [traditional pecks] of plump, solid apricot kernels.
